notes: Machine-readable compliance control register. Maps every tracked compliance control to CI test IDs and evidence IDs. Validated by scripts/check-control-register.mjs (blocking). A control moves planned -> in-progress/partial -> implemented -> verified; once implemented, ALL its tests must be passing and ALL its evidence current (fail-closed). Evidence records hold non-sensitive IDs/hashes/dates only, never confidential contracts or personal data. Controls are ordered foundation-first: governance and accountability, electoral output and neutrality, data provenance and licensing, privacy and research, product and accessibility, then security and operations.

tests.note: The consent version is centralised in apps/web/src/lib/research/consent.ts (single definition site, enforced by check-research-integrity.mjs) and read by both the client and the server. tests.note: The public research stats are k-suppressed at the DATABASE/VIEW layer, never by post-hoc JavaScript filtering: migration 0006 defines the allowlisted v_public_* views, each disclosive one gating with HAVING SUM(n) >= k where k == MIN_CELL in stats.ts; the guard pins the two together, fails an unreviewed new v_public_ cross-tab view (extending the aggregate-table allowlist to the published-view surface), proves generate-stats.ts SELECTs only from those views (never a base counter table, so a sub-k cell never leaves the DB), proves no Pages Function under functions/api/** reads a counter table or view at runtime (counters are write-only; the sole public path is the static suppressed release files), validates that every committed stats/<id>.json carries an immutable release block (k, suppression rules, content-addressed release id, date) with minCell == k, and confirms the release manifest binds the files via publicStatsHash with publicStatsRelease no longer pending.

Unit-tests the pure disclosure pipeline in stats.ts: single k across every dimension, no true bucket total emitted (shown = sum of surviving cells), per-cohort partition with no combined cell-view, sensitive dimensions national-only, only dataset parties published, and COMPLEMENTARY suppression across the national/state hierarchy (complementaryStateSuppression). A constructed differencing-attack fixture (national marginal 100 with published states 46 + 46 hiding a sub-k 8, and an unknown-state remainder folded into the marginal) proves the per-state cells are suppressed so marginal minus published states can never isolate the hidden cell.

tests.note: Privacy claims register (docs/privacy/claims.json) maps each user-facing privacy claim → substantiating control → CI test IDs → external-evidence IDs → approver/expiry → FALLBACK wording. The de-identification assessment (EV-DEIDENTIFICATION-ASSESSMENT) and provider DPAs (EV-PROVIDER-DPA) are recorded as evidence on this control.

Unit-pins the pure resolver + validators: an unbacked/expired claim (or one whose backing test is not passing / whose evidence is expired) resolves to the fallback wording; the de-id register must bind the deployed schema version + k-threshold + sensitive dimensions; orphan test/evidence references fail.

tests.note: The research ingestion transport invariants are single-sourced in apps/web/src/lib/research/transport-policy.ts (TLS-only, cache 'no-store', credentials 'omit', a fail-closed transmitted-field allowlist per endpoint, and the forbidden request-reads list) and wired into survey.ts so every research POST goes through transportInit()/projectAllowlisted — only the device-derived record can reach the wire (the raw answer vector/weights and the electorate cannot, and each proposition is projected to {id, stance}). The static scan proves the ingestion Pages Functions (functions/api/research{,/geography,/token}.ts) and the client transport never read CF-Connecting-IP / the user agent / a forwarding header and never log the request body or URL (comment-stripped, so the endpoints' 'never read' prose does not trip it), and that the code transport policy is consistent with the committed edge policy (infra/providers/cloudflare/transport-policy.json: alwaysUseHttps, minTlsVersion >= 1.2, HSTS, no request-body logging, no Logpush body, ingestion routes not cached).

Network-interception e2e: on a real opt-in flow the detailed record and the geography ping carry ONLY allowlisted fields (no raw answers/points/weights, no electorate on the detailed record, no identifier), the device-derived stances DO travel, no forbidden request header (CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-For / user-agent surrogate) is added by the client, and the geography ping carries only election + electorate + token. functions/api/** are Cloudflare Pages Functions (not run under vite preview), so the endpoints are mocked via page.route to count and inspect requests.

Pins the fail-closed projection (drops answers/points/weights/electorate/identifiers, strips a raw label/weight smuggled onto a proposition entry, keeps only {id, stance}), the no-store/no-credentials RequestInit, and the static-scan verdict (a forbidden IP/UA/body-log or a non-allowlisted transmitted field fails).
Infra aspect: the deploy guard fails closed if a preview D1/KV id equals its production counterpart, so preview traffic can never mix into the published dataset.

controls.title: Runtime correction controls and CI incident rehearsals

tests.note: The mandated incident rehearsals over the pure, fail-closed control-plane core: wrong ballot, mapping dispute, data poisoning (research + publication), revoked print approval, correction banner, and RESTORE — each proving the switch takes effect AND reverts — plus the tamper/unsigned fail-closed guarantee (every capability refused) and the scope hierarchy.

Blocking guard: the committed data/governance/control-plane.json is well-formed, its integrity digest matches its body (drift-gated by generate-control-plane.mjs), and every suspension names a REAL target (known election / registry party key / question id / ballot / map) so a mistyped selector cannot silently fail to suspend.
The synchronous runtime digest matches Node's crypto and the signer, so a tampered artefact is detected at the device, not only in CI.
The stats generator refuses to (re)publish while the `publication` scope is suspended, or the control plane is unreadable/unsigned/tampered (fail closed).

evidence.description: Periodic human tabletop exercise using the control plane against a live-like incident (the CI rehearsals are automated; this is the human-process evidence).
